evidence: The function obtains two nested-attribute provider entries through the global context path, requests selector 0x1b from each with nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts each result to signed 32-bit integer, and accumulates them at the caller-provided output pointer (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:26892-26926). No indexed callers are available; the name describes the visible data flow without assigning a domain to selector 0x1b.

The body initializes record fields, derives a sample coordinate, and on the positive path loads a flight segment, calls sampled_flight_segment_interpolate, then stores the interpolated values at record offsets +0x54, +0x58, and +0x5c (decompiled/main/main_0008.c:34151-34191). The indexed caller is evaluate_catch_loco_working_ring_position and calls this helper while building its position data (decompiled/main/main_0009.c:37929-37934). The name stays at the visible interpolation operation.

The body checks the input count and optional record pointer, reads a value through the second input pointer, consults the context-status helper and classify_record_status_against_context_statuses_1_2, then passes derived flags/status values and the record pointer to follow-up helpers; the return register is set to zero (decompiled/main/main_0076.c:7343-7381). No indexed caller is available, and the follow-up helpers do not establish a specific domain operation, so it remains unnamed.

For a non-null input, the function checks nested selector 0x2b first and returns code 1 when its value is positive; if that test fails, it checks selector 0x32 and returns code 0 when positive, otherwise code 2. Missing nested entries use the provider fallback helper. Null input returns code 2 (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:11518-11557). Its indexed caller stores the returned code into a record field (decompiled/main/main_0115.c:6522-6528). No broader domain meaning is established.

When the flag in the second argument is clear, the function loads the float at input+0x18 directly into the result vector and returns. When set, it reads a global configuration value; a missing value selects 1.0, otherwise it calls the helper, then musttail forwards the value and fixed remap parameters to linear_remap_clamped (decompiled/main/main_0029.c:17980-18005). Callers pass the flag/value pair as part of a larger chain of remapping helpers (decompiled/main/main_0148.c:14084-14088). The name describes the two observed paths without assigning the configuration a game-level meaning.
